headline: Approved sending warning letter to 88 Kilmartin Rd; removed seven properties from Old Business.
summary: Rafiq Aftab of 19 Lincoln Place raised questions about permits needed to bring a hotel to Bristol. The chief building official and mayor will discuss them after the meeting. 59 North Main St was moved to the Long Term Watch List.
decisions: Approved sending a warning letter to 88 Kilmartin Rd about encroachment onto city property by 64 Kilmartin Rd, and adding the item to the December agenda.
Approved removing 45 North Main St and 81 North Main St from Old Business.
Approved placing 59 North Main St on the Long Term Watch List.
Approved removing 83 Bellevue Ave from Old Business.
Approved removing 55 Empire Way from Old Business.
Approved removing 18 & 32 Treble Rd from Old Business.
Approved removing 98 Crown St from Old Business.
Approved removing 143 Fairfield St from Old Business.

plain_text:
CITY OF BRISTOL 
BUILDING DEPARTMENT 
111 NORTH MAIN STREET, BRISTOL, CT 06010 
OFFICE OF CHIEF BUILDING OFFICIAL 
Code Enforcement Committee Meeting Minutes 
Wednesday, November 04, 2026  
City Hall Council Chambers at 9am 
111 North Main Street, Bristol CT 06010 
 
CODE ENFORCEMENT COMMITTEE MEMBERS IN ATTENDANCE: 
 
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official (C.B.O.) 
                                                    Richard J. Hart, Code Enforcement Officer (CEO) 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor 
Kris Lambert, FMO 
                                                    Erica Mikulak, BBHD 
                                                    Lt. Eric Hansen, BPD 
                                                    Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.) 
                                                    Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.) 
 
Also in Attendance:                       Jeffrey Steeg, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C) 
                                                    Maria Theam, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C) 
                                                    Noelle Bates, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C)               
         Stephen Bynum, BPRYCS 
                                                    Jeff Arduini, BPRYCS 
                                                    Josh Corey, Public Works (P.W.) 
         John Aniolowski, BHA 
         Susan Tyler, Council Woman  
                                                    Tom Denote, Assessors Office 
                                                    Jennifer Cole, Tax Office 
                                                    Maria Theam, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C) 
                                                    Noelle Bates, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C)  
 
 
A)  Call to Order and Introductions: 
 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: Called to order the Wednesday, November 04, 2026, Code 
Enforcement Committee Meeting at 9:00AM in the Bristol City Hall Council Chambers.    
 
 
B)  Approval of October 07, 2026 Meeting Minutes:   
 
             Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor:  Motion to approve October 07, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
             Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.): Motion to Approve 
             Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: 2nd Motion 
             Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries
C)  Public Participation:  19 Lincoln Place, Rafiq Aftab – Issues pertaining to permits required 
through BBD. Interested in bringing a hotel to Bristol. CBO & Mayor to discuss after CEC 
Meeting.  
 
D) New Business:   Jeffrey Steeg, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C): 88 Kilmartin Rd – Encroachment onto City 
Property by 64 Kilmartin Rd.  
Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.): Motion to send warning letter outlining CE Process.   
            Lt. Eric Hansen, BPD: 2nd Motion. 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries - Add to December 
Agenda.  
 
 
E)  Discussion of Properties of Interest and/or Concern to Committee Members:  None 
 
 
F) Old Business: 
 
1.)  267 Main St – RJB (CBO): * PMC Violations / Board & Secure / Foreclosure:  
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: No complaints, no changes.  
 
2.) 45 North Main St - RJB (CBO): * Deteriorating/ Exterior –  
Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.): Water restored. Remove 
 
3.) 59 North Main St - RJB (CBO): * Water Shut Off / Deteriorating –  
Erica Mikulak, BBHD: Remains vacant. Move to LTWL 
 
4.) 81 North Main St - RJB (CBO): Mayor, BBD, BHA, BBHD & FMO –  
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: No outstanding violations or non-compliance. 
Remove 
 
Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.): Motion to remove 45 North Main St & 81 North 
Main St from Old Business and place 59 North Main St onto Long Term Watch List.  
Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.): 2nd Motion. 
      Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries  
 
5.) 92 Gaylord St – RJB (CBO): PMC/FMO/BBHD/Zoning:   
                  Richard J. Hart, Code Enforcement Officer (CEO): Property Mgr. has been compliant on   
      maintaining the property, there has been improvement, will continue to monitor.  
 
6.) 83 Bellevue Ave – RJB (CBO): Blight/Garbage/Interior:  
Erica Mikulak, BBHD: Site visit conducted with CEO, no new complaints. Motion to remove.  
Richard J. Hart, Code Enforcement Officer (CEO): 2nd Motion. 
       Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries  
 
7.) 55 Empire Way – RJB (CBO): Zoning/ MV:  
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: Motion to remove.  
Lt. Eric Hansen, BPD: 2nd Motion. 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries 
 
8.) 18 & 32 Treble Rd – RJB (CBO): WWP/Kennel: 
     Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: Violations addressed. Motion to remove.           
Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.):  2nd Motion. 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries
9.) 98 Crown St – EM (BBHD): Basement Condemnation: 
Erica Mikulak, BBHD: Conducted a site visit, basement has been cleared. Court order issued 
to property owner; some minor issues remain. Motion to remove.  
Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.): 2nd Motion. 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries  
 
10.)  820 Stafford Ave - RJH (CEO): PMC/Roof/Sinking Stoop:  
      Richard J. Hart, Code Enforcement Officer (CEO):  Will conduct a follow up site visit on 
      stoop repair.   
 
11.)  143 Fairfield St – RJH (CBO): Broken Window: 
 Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: Has conducted a site visit several times, left letter 
 to contact BBD, concerning broken window. Motion to remove.  
 Ray Rogozinski, Public Works (P.W.):  2nd Motion. 
 Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor: All in Favor - I - Any Opposed - Motion Carries 
 
 
G) Clean & Lien / Fix & Lien: 
 
- 252 & 252 ½ Terryville Rd – RJB (CBO): * Blight:  
Lt. Eric Hansen, BPD: 2 Vehicles were red tagged, 1 towed. 
Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.): Concerned about well.  
Jeffrey Steeg, Corp. Counsel (B.C.C):  2 emails sent to Attorney Cohen, no response.     
 
- 9 Divinity St – RJB (CBO): Motion approved 07.01.2026, TBD pending compliance:  
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: No information from the state has been 
received. The alley between the buildings was loaded with roof debris, creating a water 
dam. PW and Mr. O’Donnell cleaned it up.  
 
 
H) Long-Term Watch List: 
 
- 211 Park St - RJB (CBO /C. E): * – Hole in Culvert/ New Owner: 
Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: All 3 properties are not in good condition due 
to neglect on the buildings. Property owner was notified that the if the sewer fails, 
buildings in the back will be condemned. 
 
      -     213 Park St - RJB (CBO /C. E): * – Hole in Culvert: See notes for 211 Park St. 
 
      -     215 Park St -- RJB (CBO /C. E): * – Hole in Culvert/ New Owner: See notes for 211  
            Park St. 
 
 
I) URAA – Uniform Relocation Assisting Act:  Stephen Bynum, BPRYCS: No updates.  
 
 
J) Tax Liens:  Jennifer Cole, Tax Office (BTC): Been in discussion with Attorney Steeg on money 
that is owed by CE Properties.  
 
 
K) Next CEC Meeting:  December 02, 2026 at 9:00am, City Hall Council Chambers.
L) To Adjourn:  
 
    Robert Longo, Water Department (W.D.): Motion to Adjourn. 
   Richard J Brown, Chief Building Official: 2nd Motion. 
    Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor – All in Favor - I -Any Opposed - Motion Carries  
    Adjourned at 9:55am  
 
 
 
Per Order of the Chairperson 
 
Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Mayor
